_comment: Roost configuration TEMPLATE. Copy this file to 'config.json' in the same folder, then edit that copy. config.json is gitignored, so your personal data (goals, expenses, tax figures, client/agent names) never gets committed. Restart the server after changing.
_statements_dir: Folder holding the year subfolders (2024/, 2025/, ...), relative to this roost/ folder. Defaults to ../Statements; falls back to the Commissions root if that folder has no year folders.
_ma_reclass: Medicare Advantage new-business detection. A residual-section line is reclassified as new business when its payable is >= mult x the policy's typical recurring payment AND >= max(floor_min, 3 x global median). Raise mult/floor_min to reclassify fewer lines.
_downline_parents: Map each downline agent to their upline, e.g. { "Jane Agent": "Your Name" }. Names must match how they appear on the commission statements. Left empty in this template; your real mappings live only in your local config.json.
_note_saved_data: Goals, expenses, tax inputs, and profile settings are written into config.json by the app as you use it. They are intentionally NOT in this template and are never committed.
